dropped_for_lack_of_source: Availability in Israel: the video makes no claim either way. Israel is on the Android list (yk-availability-iw.txt:35, yk-availability-en.txt:39); the iPhone/iPad and computer variants were not captured, and setup does not need the claim.

'The passcode replaces the multiplication question' and 'a passcode keeps the kids out of settings': nothing says this. The source says only 'the multiplication question OR your custom passcode' (parental-controls-iw:45), and that the question is there to verify an adult (profiles-iw:64). The screen says 'עם שאלת הכפל, או עם הקוד'.

Passcode steps, digit count and the forgot-the-code advice: the only capture of answer 6292172 is its Computer tab (passcode-iw:1 '- מחשב -', tab row at :65; passcode-en:1 '- Computer -'). Its steps (the lock icon, the multiplication problem, 'יצירת קוד סיסמה אישי', four digits, 'שליחה') and the uninstall-to-reset advice (:55) are desktop instructions, and the Android and iPhone/iPad tabs were not captured. The video keeps only :33's general statement. To restore them, capture https://support.google.com/youtubekids/answer/6292172?hl=iw&co=GENIE.Platform%3DAndroid and ...%3DiOS, and check them against each other.
Timer minimum and maximum: only a slider is described (timer-iw:45). No time range is given.

The app's real on-screen Hebrew labels: only the help center's wording is captured, with Google's possible-AI-translation note on every page, and the pages disagree (שאלת הכפל / בעיית הכפל / התרגיל בחשבון). The age settings are shown by age only. The labels that are quoted („הגדרות”, „הגדרת טיימר”, „הפעלת טיימר”, „יציאה מהטיימר”, „הזמן נגמר!”, „עוד”, „חסימה”, „דיווח”) are UI names as the help center gives them, and the setting's name „תוכן מאושר בלבד” is its heading (parental-controls-iw:125, important-info-iw:88); the end card says the wording may differ on your device. The option label „לאישור התוכן בעצמך” (singular address) is not shown: the video's own words always address parents in the plural.

Ads in 'approved content only' mode: important-info-iw:132 says paid ads may be shown when kids play a video in the app, and gives no exception for this setting. The video says nothing about ads, and its wording follows parental-controls-iw:127 ('צופים רק בסרטונים, בערוצים ובאוספים שאתם בחרתם'), not 'everything they see is what you chose'. Collections are grouped by YouTube Kids' teams or partners (:127); the parent picks which ones.

The English original of important-info (answer 6130561) was not captured, and the Hebrew page is AI-translated. So its categorical 'search videos are not human-reviewed' (:76) is said as 'some videos in search were not human-reviewed', which profiles-iw:118 and :120 also support.
Supervised accounts on regular YouTube in Israel, the age that applies in Israel, and YouTube Premium in Israel: none were captured, and none are mentioned.

Steps to pause search history, and the steps to reach the search switch: the linked articles were not captured (parental-controls-iw:161, :243). The video says only that search is turned off in the parental controls (important-info-iw:78).

Device coverage: the step chains come from the Android pages (parental-controls-iw, timer-iw) and from pages without a device choice (block-iw, flag-iw). iPhone/iPad and web variants were not captured; the end card names the Android version. The TV parent code (parental-controls-iw:255) is sourced but was left out for length.
Any advice on how much screen time is right, or at what age to start: no source, so none is given.
voice_notes: Voice gate (asr_gate.py on the rendered line files, 29.9.2026): all 26 lines pass CER <= 0.05 and the meaning check (negations, number words and person forms heard exactly). Worst: s4b-search-caveat-1 at 0.050, where the only difference is the spelling משלם for מושלם.

Residuals a listener may still hear as slips, none of them a meaning word: בחיפוש heard as בהיפוש (ח as ה), להשבית as להשביט, לצפות as ליצפות, בסוף as סוף, ערוץ as ערו, עובדת as עובת, מחוברים as מהוברים, במרכז as ברכז. 'טיימר' was heard as טייר (0.158, also as raw IPA), so the timer line says 'בוחרים בהגדרות כמה זמן לצפות'. 'שימו לב' lost its ב, 'נבדקים מסביב לשעון' failed at 0.07-0.30, 'בדפי העזרה' and 'בכתובת שעל המסך' failed at 0.10-0.29; the lines that replaced them are in the scenes.
